title: ID0442155-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312561850/18] terminal is faulty
description:
Reported issue: I am opening a ticket on this terminal because the problem seemed to be solved a few days ago, according to Siemens. Only the OCPP communication was missing, which required the configuration of the OCPP SIM. However, the terminal is currently faulty with the error messages present on SCB. The charger has been unavailable for a very long time...
